notes.title: "All-Front Assault" is now available on Steam
notes.content: [p]Many significant modifications and extensive testing have been carried out since the last update, and now the game has been officially launched. Welcome everyone to give it a try and make a purchase. The game will continue to receive regular updates. Thank you all for your attention![/p]

notes.title: The optimization phase for combat rhythm has been completed
notes.content:
We’ve finalized the overhaul of our combat gameplay mechanics. The overall playability and strategic depth have seen significant improvements. We’d love to hear your feedback or suggestions after trying out the new system—thank you!

The revamped combat now operates in a turn-based mode. During the preparation phase, you’ll select reinforcement strategies using a deck-building system, then deploy your squads for either defense or offense. In the attack phase, you’ll directly command one squad while the remaining units execute actions based on preset AI behaviors.

notes.title: Combat pace optimization
notes.content:
I‘m making a significant attempt at a gameplay update, aiming to optimize and adjust the combat pace of the game.

1 The main mission will be transformed into a survival mode. Surviving through 10 waves of enemy attacks signifies victory in the level.

2 The rhythm of enemy attacks will follow a cycle of "Enemies Gathering" - "Enemies Launching Attacks" - "Enemies Eliminated" - "Select Reinforcements".

3 Reinforcements will become more randomized, presented in a card - like format during the "Select Reinforcements" phase. Players can choose to bring in a hero squad, several regular rangers, enhance a specific type of troop, or opt for turrets, aircraft, and warships.

This approach will make the selection of reinforcements more strategic, improve the overall combat rhythm, allow players to focus on devising their strategies when configuring reinforcements, and concentrate on controlling their teams during battles.
